description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Listing/SaveBulkPublish. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Saves a batch of URLs for bulk publication and returns one result per line. ownerAgent: publication. SearchTerms: save bulk publish, bulk publish, bulk publishing, mass publication, publicar en bulk. Use when: Use it when the client needs to know exactly which line was processed and which line was rejected without summarizing only by counts. Use it when selected products are source product URLs, Amazon URLs, ASIN URLs converted to source URLs, or source-page URLs. Do not use it to get existing listings or search candidates. Input: data: SaveAutolistRequest. Main fields: listings: string[][], listFrequencyMinutes: int, dontListUntil: DateTime?, reviewBeforePublishing: bool, createdBy: int, ignoreVero: bool, ignoreOOS: bool, optimizeTitle: bool, optimizeDescription: bool, optimizeFields: bool, publishVariations: bool, WeListForYou: bool. listings is string[][] where each row is [sourceUrl, optionalTitle]; sourceUrl is the supplier/source product URL to publish. Use reviewBeforePublishing for pending review, optimizeTitle/optimizeDescription/optimizeFields for optimization choices, and listFrequencyMinutes/dontListUntil for delayed publication. Do not send CatalogSubmitRequest.ProductsToList here. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Internal client fields are managed by the tool and are not tool inputs. Output: Returns SaveBulkPublishLineStatus[] in the same order as listings. Values: Processed, ForbiddenWordsUrl, DuplicatedUrl, InvalidUrl, InvalidSourceUrl, ExistingListing, NoQuota, InvalidGenerator or DuplicatedProductSource. Search terms: listing savebulkpublish. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally. Internal-only request fields are removed automatically before the HGRApi request is sent.
